sentences.en: They created the fakie website, and they also had to send a playback operator and a playback technician to make all the videos pop up on our various screens.
sentences.zh: 他们制作了这个假网站，还必须派出一名回放操作员和一名回放技术员，让所有视频出现在我们各种屏幕上。

sentences.en: And then, we had a fan catch from Frankie C.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们收到了一位来自华盛顿州西雅图的粉丝弗兰基·C的来信，他说：

sentences.en: My name is Frankie, and I'm 14 years old.
sentences.zh: 我已经看了五遍《办公室》了，我对《告密者》那一集的开场戏有个疑问。”

sentences.en: I have watched The Office five times, and I have a question about the cold open of Whistleblower.
sentences.zh: 好的，弗兰基，你想问什么？
迈克尔让整个办公室的人看他的视频，所有人的电脑都在同时播放声音。

sentences.en: Michael asked the whole office to watch his video, and everyone's sound is playing at the same time.
sentences.zh: 但你们在之前的播客中提到过，奥斯卡是唯一一个电脑里真的有声音的人。

sentences.en: But you guys have mentioned in previous podcasts that Oscar was the only one to really have sound on his computer.

sentences.zh: 那么，这是怎么做到的呢？
嗯，兰迪说所有的电脑播放视频时都没有声音，他们实际上是在后期的制作中才把声音加进去的。

sentences.en: Well, Randy said all of the computers ran the videos without sound, and they actually added that in later in post-production.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们是在假装对声音做出反应。

sentences.en: So, we're fakie reacting to sound.

sentences.zh: 真实的视频，虚假的声音。
最后，兰迪说小水獭的视频是来自加州蒙特雷水族馆的素材。

sentences.en: And finally, Randy said that the video of the baby otters was footage from the Monterey, California, Aquarium.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，水獭最终并没有做出迈克尔在最后采访片段中描述的任何动作。

sentences.en: But, you know, the otters do not end up doing any of the things that Michael describes in his final talking head.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你没看到太多视频内容，因为它们对不上。

sentences.en: That's why you don't see too much of the video, because it wouldn't match.
sentences.zh: 视频只是在迈克尔的脸上呈现出来。

sentences.en: It just kind of plays out on Michael's face.

sentences.zh: 以一种最令人愉悦的方式。
你准备好迎接一个最令人惊叹、最引人注目的场景了吗？有人一边说话，一边剪着报纸。

sentences.en: Are you ready for one of the most amazing, commanding scenes of someone talking and just cutting up a piece of newspaper?
I watched it three times in a row.
I was mesmerized by the scene.
sentences.zh: 大家伙儿，我正在给珍娜看我的纸。

sentences.en: I'm showing Jenna my paper, you guys.
sentences.zh: 乔·贝内特要来了，她来势汹汹。

sentences.en: Joe Bennett is going to arrive, and she is coming in hot.

sentences.zh: 她带着两个律师和她的狗进来了。

sentences.en: She comes in with two lawyers and her dogs.

sentences.zh: 她接着解释说，报纸刊登了一篇关于赛博公司廉价的外国打印机攻击无辜美国人的报道。

sentences.en: And she goes on to explain that the newspaper has run a story about Saber's cheap foreign printers attacking innocent Americans.
sentences.zh: 当她说这些话的时候，她在房间里走来走去。

sentences.en: And while she's saying all of this, she's moving around the room.
She's getting a pair of scissors.

sentences.zh: 当她进行这段对话时，我最喜欢的时刻之一是凯文说：

sentences.en: As she has this dialogue, one of my favorite moments is when Kevin was like,
I think I know what happened.
sentences.zh: 我想我知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: And she goes, I don't think you do.
And then he goes, no, I'm thinking I don't.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，不，我想我确实不知道。

sentences.en: But she's doing so much action while having all of this different emotion.
sentences.zh: 但她在表现出所有这些不同情绪的同时，还有那么多动作戏。

sentences.en: It reminded me of that scene in Secret Santa when Michael had to go from Santa to Jesus all in one moment with his clothing.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了《秘密圣诞老人》里的那一幕，迈克尔必须在瞬间通过服装从圣诞老人变身为耶稣。

sentences.en: Well, we had a fan question from Anne S.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们有一个来自瑞士苏黎世安妮·S的粉丝提问，她说，

sentences.en: can you explain Joe's insane choice to walk all the way over to Angela's desk to grab a glue stick,
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下乔为什么要做出那种疯狂的选择，大老远走到安吉拉的桌子前去拿一根胶棒，

sentences.en: to glue the newspaper article to the picture of the office instead of using tape?
sentences.zh: 而不是用胶带把那篇报纸文章贴在办公室的照片上吗？

sentences.en: I looked in the script, and all of this stage direction is meticulously outlined within the dialogue.
sentences.zh: 我查了剧本，所有这些舞台指示都在对话中被详细地列了出来。

sentences.en: There is like this whole silent play that is scripted out, and I thought I would read it.
sentences.zh: 剧本里写了一整段默剧表演，我想我把它读出来。

sentences.en: And then I have a little tidbit about when she comes to my desk.
sentences.zh: 然后关于她走到我桌子前的那一段，我还有一个小花絮。

sentences.en: Here's what it said in the script.
Now, mind you, within all of this, there's also dialogue.
sentences.zh: 请注意，在所有这些动作中，还有对话。

sentences.en: You're just reading the stage directions.
Joe enters with a couple of well-dressed lawyers.
sentences.zh: 乔带着几个衣着考究的律师进来了。

sentences.en: Joe pulls out a copy of the Times-Tribune off Jim's desk and casually flips through it.
sentences.zh: 乔从吉姆的桌子上拿了一份《时代论坛报》，漫不经心地翻阅着。

sentences.en: Joe points to an article titled, Saber Defends Printers.
sentences.zh: 乔指着一篇题为《赛博捍卫打印机》的文章。

sentences.en: As Joe speaks, she walks over to Dwight's desk and grabs a pair of scissors.
sentences.zh: 乔一边说话，一边走到德怀特的桌子前，拿了一把剪刀。

sentences.en: Dwight looks like he might say something but swallows.
sentences.zh: 德怀特看起来想说点什么，但又咽了回去。

sentences.en: Joe methodically cuts out the article.
sentences.zh: 乔有条不紊地剪下了那篇文章。

sentences.en: Joe slowly carries the article toward accounting, dropping the scissors on Jim's desk as she walks.
sentences.zh: 乔慢慢地带着文章走向会计部，走的时候把剪刀扔在了吉姆的桌子上。

sentences.en: Dwight is about to grab his scissors.
sentences.zh: 德怀特正要去拿他的剪刀。

sentences.en: Jim pulls them just out of his reach.
sentences.zh: 吉姆把剪刀拉开，让他够不着。

sentences.en: Joe starts rummaging over the tops of Oscar, Angela, and Kevin's desk looking for something.
sentences.zh: 乔开始在奥斯卡、安吉拉和凯文的桌子上翻找东西。

sentences.en: Finally, she finds it on Angela's desk, a glue stick.
sentences.zh: 最后，她在安吉拉的桌子上找到了它，一根胶棒。

sentences.en: Joe walks in a circle toward Michael's office while rubbing glue on the back of the article.
sentences.zh: 乔一边往迈克尔办公室的方向绕圈走，一边在文章背面涂胶水。

sentences.en: Joe slams the article onto Pam's painting.
sentences.zh: 乔把文章猛地拍在帕姆的画上。

sentences.en: Pam looks to Jim like, what the F?
sentences.zh: 帕姆看着吉姆，那表情仿佛在说，搞什么鬼？

sentences.en: Dwight smiles smugly at Pam like, that's what you get.
sentences.zh: 德怀特得意地冲帕姆笑了笑，仿佛在说，这就是你的下场。

sentences.en: That was all in the script.
And I remember us rehearsing it, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 我还记得我们排练的时候，珍娜。

sentences.en: We rehearsed all of this because it was like a one-act play, and Kathy had to walk around the room and engage with all of us.
sentences.zh: 我们排练了所有这些，因为它就像一出独幕剧，凯西必须在房间里走来走去，与我们每个人互动。

sentences.en: I thought it was great when I rewatched it because you really feel her presence amongst all the workers.
sentences.zh: 重看的时候我觉得这很棒，因为你真的能感受到她在所有员工中的存在感。

sentences.en: The way they staged her walking through the bullpen.
sentences.zh: 他们安排她穿过办公区的走位方式。

sentences.en: But here's what I wanted to share.
If you go to three minutes, six seconds, that's when Joe crosses to Angela's desk for the glue stick.
sentences.zh: 如果你看到三分零六秒，那就是乔走到安吉拉桌前拿胶棒的时候。

sentences.en: And this was the moment in rehearsal when Kathy Bates walked over to my desk, and I was really cold, and I had my heater cranked, and it had been cranked all morning.
sentences.zh: 这就是排练时凯西·贝茨走到我桌子前的那一刻，当时我真的很冷，我把取暖器开到了最大，而且整个上午都开着。

sentences.en: And she said, it's like the Sahara over here.
sentences.zh: 她说，这儿简直像撒哈拉沙漠一样。

sentences.en: I wrote about it in our book, The Office BFF.
sentences.zh: 我在我们的书《办公室闺蜜》里写过这件事。

sentences.en: Because I, with my foot, went under the desk to try to turn my heater off.
sentences.zh: 因为我当时想用脚伸到桌子底下把加热器关掉。

sentences.en: And I was, like, so embarrassed.
I was like, oh, no, Kathy Bates, like, my desk area is so hot.
sentences.zh: 我心想，天哪，凯西·贝茨，我的办公桌区域太热了。

sentences.en: As soon as I rewatched it, I was like, that was the time.
sentences.zh: 我重温那一集时，心想，就是那次了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I wondered if that was the time.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我也在想是不是那次。

sentences.en: Well, at the end of all of this, Michael is trying to tell Joe, listen, nobody in our office spoke to the press.
sentences.zh: 总之，在这一切的最后，迈克尔试图告诉乔，听着，我们办公室没人向媒体透露过消息。
不是我们这儿的任何人。

sentences.en: And she's kind of like, Andy, you better say it was you.
sentences.zh: 她当时就像是在说，安迪，你最好承认是你干的。

sentences.en: He said he will break her glasses, right, and poke them in her eyeball or something?
sentences.zh: 他说他要弄碎她的眼镜，对吧，然后把碎片戳进她的眼球里还是什么的？

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, the little nubs of your glasses that sit on your nose?
sentences.zh: 对，你知道眼镜架在鼻梁上的那个小鼻托吗？

sentences.en: There's a name for them, and he says he's going to break them off and poke them in her eyes.
sentences.zh: 那东西有个名字，他说他要把它们掰下来戳进她的眼睛里。

sentences.en: Well, he has a talking head where he explains that he is no whistleblower.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他有个采访镜头，解释说他绝不是告密者。

sentences.en: In fact, generations of Bernards have made their money by silencing whistleblowers.
sentences.zh: 事实上，伯纳德家族几代人都是靠让告密者闭嘴来赚钱的。

sentences.en: In fact, Woody Guthrie wrote a song about them.
sentences.zh: 事实上，伍迪·格思里还为他们写过一首歌。

sentences.en: For those of you who don't know who Woody Guthrie is, he was, by all accounts on the internet and people who love folk music,
sentences.zh: 对于那些不知道伍迪·格思里是谁的人，据互联网和所有热爱民谣音乐的人所说，

sentences.en: one of the most significant figures in American folk music.
sentences.zh: 他是美国民谣音乐界最重要的人物之一。

sentences.en: He was, quote, a poet of the people.
His songs captured the heart of hard economic times and war.
sentences.zh: 他的歌捕捉到了艰难经济时期和战争中的人心。

sentences.en: One of his songs you might all know is This Land Is Your Land.
sentences.zh: 你们可能都听过他的一首歌，叫《这片土地是你的土地》。

sentences.en: And incidentally, he was born today.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，他就是今天出生的。

sentences.en: He was born on July 14th, which is the day we're recording this.
sentences.zh: 他出生于7月14日，也就是我们录制这一集的日子。

sentences.en: We got some mail from Barrett G.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了来自阿肯色州巴雷特·G的来信，

sentences.en: Have y'all heard the awesome song someone made from that snippet that Andy sang about his family being whistleblowers?
sentences.zh: 你们听过有人把安迪唱的那段关于他家族是告密者的片段做成的超棒歌曲吗？

sentences.en: It's by someone named Stormlight on SoundCloud.
From ashes they rose up, from nothing they came.
sentences.zh: 他们从灰烬中崛起，从虚无中走来。

sentences.en: From utter damnation, Bernard was their name.
sentences.zh: 从彻底的诅咒中，他们以伯纳德为名。

sentences.en: The shame of their past drove them near the insane.
sentences.zh: 过去的耻辱让他们几近疯狂。

sentences.en: When all of it crumbled while others they blamed.
sentences.zh: 当一切崩塌，而他们却在指责他人。

sentences.en: Desperate for money, but with nothing to show.
They stooped to the lowest a person could go.
sentences.zh: 他们堕落到了人所能及的最低点。

sentences.en: Well, who are the ones who will tell what they know?
sentences.zh: 那么，谁会说出他们所知道的一切呢？

sentences.en: Make sure they sleep with the fishes.
Mr. Bernard, who have you silenced today?
sentences.zh: 伯纳德先生，你今天让谁闭嘴了？

sentences.en: Mr. Bernard, oh, Mr. Bernard, how will you make them pay?
sentences.zh: 伯纳德先生，噢，伯纳德先生，你打算怎么让他们付出代价？

sentences.en: That the Bernard family are notorious for silencing people who are trying to do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 伯纳德家族以让那些试图做正确之事的人闭嘴而臭名昭著。

sentences.en: He's like, there's no way I can be a whistleblower because we are silenced whistleblowers.
sentences.zh: 他说，我不可能成为举报人，因为我们都是被噤声的举报人。

sentences.en: My gosh, what a beautiful voice.
It's really, really a good song parody.
sentences.zh: 这真是一首非常、非常棒的歌曲恶搞。

sentences.en: Well, here's a little tidbit from Warren and Halstead and also Randy, because, Jenna, you always reach out to Randy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这里有个来自沃伦、霍尔斯特德还有兰迪的小花絮，因为，珍娜，你总是联系兰迪。

sentences.en: And they said the song was not in the script.
sentences.zh: 他们说这首歌并不在剧本里。

sentences.en: Randy said that Paul pitched the lyrics on the day.
sentences.zh: 兰迪说保罗是当天才写出的歌词。

sentences.en: And Warren and Halstead said, Jenna, Ed had such a great talent for coming up with a tune and being able to make up a song.
sentences.zh: 沃伦和霍尔斯特德说，珍娜，埃德在创作曲调和即兴编歌方面有着极高的天赋。

sentences.en: And they could really rely on him.
And so they found this on the day.
sentences.zh: 所以他们是在当天发现这个的。

sentences.en: So Paul wrote the lyrics and then Ed just sort of sang a melody.
sentences.zh: 所以保罗写了歌词，然后埃德就随口唱出了一段旋律。

sentences.en: See, if you gave me lyrics, my melody would be so awful.
sentences.zh: 你看，如果你给我歌词，我的旋律会难听得要命。

sentences.en: Oh, I feel like I only have one melody.
sentences.zh: 噢，我觉得我好像只会一种旋律。

sentences.en: And it's like that whenever I improvise any song.
sentences.zh: 每次我即兴创作任何歌曲时都是这样。

sentences.en: It's like sitting here talking to Jenna.
sentences.zh: 就像坐在这里和珍娜聊天一样。

sentences.en: Ed is just an amazing musician.
sentences.zh: 埃德真是一位了不起的音乐家。

sentences.en: Well, he's a songwriter in my life, too.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他也是我生活中的词曲作者。

sentences.en: Well, Joe is determined to get to the bottom of this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，乔决心要查个水落石出。

sentences.en: She's going to find out who that whistleblower is.
sentences.zh: 她要找出那个举报人是谁。

sentences.en: She has an amazing talking head where she talks about when her mom worked as a prison guard and something went missing.
sentences.zh: 她有一个很棒的单人访谈片段，讲述了她妈妈当狱警时东西失窃的事。

sentences.en: To find the guilty party, she would ask everyone what they would do as punishment to the person who stole.
sentences.zh: 为了找出罪魁祸首，她会问每个人如果抓到小偷会怎么惩罚对方。

sentences.en: And if they said, oh, you know, you got to, like, go hard on them, she knew they were innocent.
sentences.zh: 如果他们说，噢，你知道，你得严惩他们，她就知道他们是无辜的。

sentences.en: But if they said, you know, maybe they had a reason, blah, blah, that's whose rectum would have been searched.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们说，你知道，也许他们有苦衷之类的，那个人就是会被搜身检查直肠的对象。

sentences.en: Her delivery on that line, that was the anus aid check, is so good.
sentences.zh: 她在那句台词上的演绎，就是那个肛门检查，真是太棒了。
那简直是天才般的喜剧演绎。

sentences.en: Because she puts nothing on it.
sentences.zh: 因为她表现得云淡风轻。

sentences.en: She never, ever, as a performer, looks like she's trying too hard.
sentences.zh: 作为表演者，她从不、绝不表现出用力过猛的样子。

sentences.en: I do have a random background check during this talking head.
sentences.zh: 在这次访谈中，我确实进行了一次随机的背景调查。

sentences.en: Did anyone else out there notice how much unopened mail is at Dunder Mifflin?
sentences.zh: 还有人注意到邓德·米夫林公司有多少未拆封的邮件吗？

sentences.en: There were three enormous bins of unopened mail just sitting there.
sentences.zh: 那里放着三大箱未拆封的邮件。

sentences.en: I'm so confused by the mail system at Dunder Mifflin.
sentences.zh: 邓德·米夫林的邮件系统让我非常困惑。

sentences.en: But sometimes moves, but really never moves.
sentences.zh: 有时会动，但其实从不动弹。

sentences.en: We don't have a mail room.
I don't understand if that's outgoing mail.
sentences.zh: 我不明白那是寄出的邮件。

sentences.en: I don't understand if it's incoming mail.
I don't understand how it's distributed.
sentences.zh: 我不明白它是怎么分发的。

sentences.en: Well, apparently it just sits there by the conference room.
sentences.zh: 好吧，显然它就一直堆在会议室旁边。

sentences.en: The next thing Joe is going to do is bring Michael into the conference room and ask what
sentences.zh: 乔接下来要做的事，就是把迈克尔叫进会议室，问他

sentences.en: they should do when they find the whistleblower.
sentences.zh: 找到告密者后该怎么办。

sentences.en: Well, Michael says they should just ship them off to Montego Bay, where they keep all of
sentences.zh: 迈克尔说应该把他们直接发配到蒙特哥湾，那是他们关押

sentences.en: Joe gives a look to camera in that moment.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，乔对着镜头看了一眼。

sentences.en: Well, here's an interesting tidbit about that scene.
sentences.zh: 关于那个场景，有个有趣的内幕。

sentences.en: Halstead shared that at this time on the show, they were interviewing a new writer, Amelie
sentences.zh: 哈尔斯特德分享说，当时剧组正在面试一位新编剧，艾米莉·吉列特，

sentences.en: Gillette, who was a very funny AV club writer.
sentences.zh: 她曾是《影音俱乐部》的一位非常风趣的撰稿人。

sentences.en: All the writers were big fans of her.
sentences.zh: 所有编剧都是她的忠实粉丝。

sentences.en: And she visited set the day they were filming the scene between Joe and Michael in the conference
sentences.zh: 她去片场探班的那天，正好在拍乔和迈克尔在会议室的

sentences.en: It was her first time on a television set.
sentences.zh: 那是她第一次来到电视片场。

sentences.en: And Halstead said they wanted to give her a feel for what it would be like to work on
sentences.zh: 哈尔斯特德说，他们想让她感受一下在这里工作
